How to Become a HubSpot
Technology Partner.
The official start of becoming a HubSpot Technology Partner is when
you have an integration listed on the HubSpot Marketplace.
Review all information listed below online.
Considering becoming a HubSpot Technology Partner?
1. EVALUATE
View our comprehensive resource hub, offering developers
tailored guidance for their speciﬁc use cases.
2. EXPLORE OUR DEVELOPER TOOLS
Ready to start building your app or exploring how to do so? Follow these steps.
3. BUILD
4. LAUNCH
The Key Step to Start the Partnership
Ready to list your app and officially
become a HubSpot Technology
Partner? Follow these best practices
to bring your app to market.
List your app in the marketplace.
Do not use ‘Hub’ or ‘HubSpot’ in your app Name.
Make sure to spell “HubSpot” correctly in your app, app listing, and collaterals.
Steps for Creating a Setup Guide for the HubSpot Marketplace.
Optimize your app listing - marketplace Checklist.
Use HubSpot's branding guidelines.
Bring your app to market.
You’ll get an email from us at technology-partners@hubspot.com with
best practices once you’re officially approved to be listed the Marketplace.
Press release template for listed apps.
Review developer API documentation & resources.
Create a HubSpot developer account and start a public app (aka integration).
Create a Developer Test Account to test your app.
Review the marketplace listing requirements.
Check out the requirements and beneﬁts of joining the HubSpot Technology Partner Program
to gain exposure to more than 278,000 companies using HubSpot to scale.
Read the IDC report to learn more about the $36b ecosystem opportunity with HubSpot.
Check out the Technology Partner Program guide for more information about the program.
Center of Developer Excellence.
Everything you need to build on HubSpot, including APIs, SDKs, sample apps, and hands-on guides.
Already have an app listed on the HubSpot Marketplace?
Check out our resources and best practices to help you grow adoption.
5. GROW
Use our post-listing checklist.
Recruit ratings and reviews.
Measure your app’s performance and address
customer feedback.
Get certiﬁed in the marketplace.
Learn from top-performing technology partners.
Press release template for certiﬁed apps.
Keep your listing content fresh and accurate.
Is there a cost to the Technology Partner Program?
No. HubSpot does not charge developers a fee to build
on HubSpot. There is no fee for installs generated through
the marketplace. Check out the Technology Partner Program
Agreement here.
Do I need to build an app with HubSpot before
becoming a technology partner?
Yes, becoming a technology partner starts with building an app
with HubSpot, and applying to list it in the marketplace through
your developer account.
What are the requirements to join the Technology
Partner Program?
Please ﬁnd all the requirements here.
How do I get the ﬁrst 3 active installs of my app
in order to join the program?
Recruiting beta users from your existing customer base who
already use HubSpot as well as customers who have requested
the integration! Apps/integrations do not require marketplace
listings to be installed. OAuth authorization URLs (as speciﬁed
in our documentation here) can be initiated from anywhere.
We deﬁne an active install as a unique customer account making
at least one API in the last 30 days, test accounts do not count
towards this metric.
Can we view any success metrics on our app?
You can view performance metrics for any app listed in the
Marketplace in your developer account. Learn more.
What is the best way for us to launch our app?
Check out the best practices to bring your app to market here.
How can I feature my integration with HubSpot
more prominently in the HubSpot user experience?
There are a few ways to embed your solution more prominently
inside HubSpot, such as:
● UI Extensions (App Cards) - Bring your product directly into
HubSpot with interactive, in-CRM experiences. Customers can
view data, take action, and complete workﬂows without ever
leaving HubSpot.
● Custom Workﬂow Actions - Automate your product as part
of HubSpot workﬂows. Customers can trigger actions in your
app automatically based on CRM events, saving time and
reducing manual work.
● CRM Timeline Events - Surface important activity from your
product directly on CRM records, giving teams full visibility
into what’s happening without switching tools.
● Calling Extensions SDK - Make and log phone calls directly
from HubSpot using your calling platform, keeping
communication and CRM data perfectly in sync.
● Video Conferencing Extension - Add your video meeting links
automatically when scheduling meetings in HubSpot, creating
a seamless booking experience for customers and prospects.
● Media Bridge API - Sync video or audio content and
engagement data into HubSpot, so teams can see how
contacts interact with media across the customer journey.
I’d like HubSpot to resell my app for me. Is this
what the Technology Partner Program is for?
No, the Technology Partner Program is for app builders who wish
to list quality apps in the HubSpot Marketplace. For an overview
of other types of partner programs, visit the partners homepage.
Need more help? Email technology-partners@hubspot.com
